text:
Maria Torres: FYFY I opened a small PR to clean up the SOC2 'Evidence playbook' page — mostly audit log export examples and one broken link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/docs/pull/4538 :eyes:
Jon Patel: thanks — skimmed. main ask: remove wording that says 'we retain customer payloads' and replace with TTL language.
Kevin Liu: also found the curl snippet uses an old header. should be `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` not `Redwood-API-Key`.
Samira Reed: @Maria can we make the retention example explicit: "events retained for 90 days by default, configurable per-tenant"? Legal prefers that.
Maria Torres: yes — I'll change the sentence to "default retention window: 90 days; customers may configure a shorter retention period via their settings".
Elin Berg: nit: the python SDK snippet uses `client.audit_export()` with `page` param. our latest SDK uses `cursor` and `limit`. we should update both curl and py examples.
Kevin Liu: good catch. propose new curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"from":"2025-12-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2025-12-31T23:59:59Z","cursor":null,"limit":500}'
```
Maria Torres: I'll swap that in. also one link in the troubleshooting section points to an internal confluence path that 404s for external reviewers — changing to /docs/internal/evidence-playbook -> /docs/evidence-playbook.
legal-bot: @Maria flagged. Suggest phrasing: avoid "we never surface customer PII"; instead use "our export tooling redacts PII by default; operators can request raw exports under a signed agreement".
Samira Reed: that reads better. Also add brief note about KMS: "Exports are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys for Private deployments".
Jon Patel: for release notes, add a line: "docs: clarify audit export examples and retention language (SOC2)".
Elin Berg: after updates, I'll run the snippet linter (docs-ci/snippet-check) and post results here.
Maria Torres: pushed commit 2 with changes, updated curl & py examples, fixed link, and adjusted retention phrasing. https://github.com/redwood/inference/docs/pull/4538/commits/2
Jon Patel: looked quick — LGTM besides one grammar nit in the list under examples.
Kevin Liu: :+1: verified header change and cursor param.
Samira Reed: :thumbsup: adding to compliance checklist for the next SOC2 dry run.
Elin Berg: docs-ci/snippet-check ran: 0 failures, 1 warning (line length in code block). posting log: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/docs/4538
Maria Torres: thanks all — I'll merge after legal signoff. @legal-bot can you confirm the final phrasing?
legal-bot: Reviewed. Approve pending one change: replace "operators" with "authorized personnel" in the export access sentence.
Maria Torres: done — commit 3 pushed. merging after CI green.
Jon Patel: cheers, great cleanup.
Maria Torres: merged and backported to v-next. closing the thread. :party:
